thread.title: J.P. Morgan Chase, Goldman stocks lead early Dow gainers

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: J.P. Morgan Chase, Goldman stocks lead early Dow gainers
text: Shares of J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. JPM, +2.49% rallied 1.7% in premarket trade Friday, to lead the Dow Jones Industrial Average's DJIA, +1.21% early gainers, after the banking giant got the first-quarter earnings reporting season on a bright note. J.P. Morgan's rally was also boosting shares of Goldman Sachs Group Inc. GS, +2.63% which rallied 1.1% premarket to be the second-biggest early Dow gainer. The implied price gains of both stocks would add about 33 points to the Dow's price, while Dow futures YMM8, +0.61% rose 143 points. Among other premarket Dow gainers, General Electric Co.'s stock GE, +1.62% rose 0.9% and Apple Inc. shares AAPL, +0.99% tacked on 0.5%.
